issues.description: Class field Bitmap24::width has different types in the template and solution headers. In template/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (line 33) the field is declared as 'short width;'. In solution/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (line 33) the field is declared as 'int width;'. This mismatch can confuse students comparing template and solution code and may lead to subtle differences (implicit conversions, range/overflow or sign assumptions) when code (constructors, buffer allocations) treats width as a full-int value elsewhere.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24::width declaration consistent between template and solution. Recommended: change the template header declaration to 'int width;' to match the solution (and the uses in Bitmap24.cpp), or if a smaller type is intentionally required, update the solution and all usages to use 'short' with an explicit rationale and checks. Ensure both header and implementation use the same type.
